title: Best Meeting Point
description: Find the point that minimizes the total travel distance to all 1s in a binary grid.
pseudocode:
1. Collect all row indices of 1s in order.
2. Collect all col indices of 1s in order.
3. Median row = rows[rows.length / 2].
4. Median col = cols[cols.length / 2].
5. Calculate distance: sum(|r - medianRow| + |c - medianCol| for all points).

steps.note: Collecting row indices of 1s from the grid.
Collecting column indices of 1s in sorted order.
Calculating total Manhattan distance to the median point (0, 0).
